verdict.rationale: Attio ships an official, extensively documented TypeScript/React App SDK. It covers record actions, widgets, tabs, pages, workflow blocks, a GraphQL data API, server functions calling the REST API, connections, forms, charts, webhooks and debugging. It is explicitly designed for AI-assisted development, with bootstrapped AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files and a CLI. Missing for 10: any evidence of official general-purpose REST API client libraries (and no public OpenAPI spec was found to generate them), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK.
